+name: mise setup
+description: Set up mise environment and install Ruby gems, Python packages, and npm packages
+inputs:
+  toolchain:
+    description: Whether to pull/build the RISC-V toolchain container (for C++ jobs)
+    default: 'false'
+runs:
+  using: composite
+  steps:
+    - uses: jdx/mise-action@v2
+    # Set bundler gem path before restoring the cache and before bin/setup,
+    # so bundle install (inside bin/setup) writes to the cacheable path.
+    - name: Set bundler PATH
+      shell: bash
+      run: bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle'
+    # Write toolchain preference to .toolchain-local so bin/setup (section 7)
+    # finds it and section 8 behaves correctly without prompting.
+    - name: Configure toolchain
+      shell: bash
+      run: |
+        if [[ "${{ inputs.toolchain }}" == "true" ]]; then
+          echo "UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1" > .toolchain-local
+          echo "UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+        else
+          echo "UDB_TOOLCHAIN_NONE=1" > .toolchain-local
+          echo "UDB_TOOLCHAIN_NONE=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+        fi
+    # Docker Buildx must be available before bin/setup runs, because bin/setup
+    # section 8 may call _pull_or_build_toolchain_image which uses buildx in CI.
+    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+      if: inputs.toolchain == 'true'
+      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3.12.0
+    - name: Login to GHCR
+      if: inputs.toolchain == 'true'
+      uses: docker/login-action@c94ce9fb468520275223c153574b00df6fe4bcc9 # v3.7.0
+      with:
+        registry: ghcr.io
+        username: ${{ github.actor }}
+        password: ${{ github.token }}
+    # Restore all four caches BEFORE bin/setup runs.  bin/setup has idempotency
+    # guards in each section (bundle check, extconf.rb file checks, node_modules
+    # directory check, uv sync lockfile check) that skip work when the cache hit
+    # already populated the relevant paths.  This means bin/setup completes in
+    # seconds on a cache hit without any separate install steps.
+    - name: Cache bundler gems
+      uses: actions/cache@v4
+      with:
+        path: vendor/bundle
+        key: bundler-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('.mise.toml', 'Gemfile.lock', 'tools/ruby-gems/*/Gemfile.lock', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/Z3_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/ESPRESSO_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/EQNTOTT_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/MUST_VERSION') }}
+    - name: Cache udb native deps (z3, espresso, eqntott, must)
+      uses: actions/cache@v4
+      with:
+        path: ~/.cache/udb
+        key: udb-deps-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/Z3_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/ESPRESSO_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/EQNTOTT_VERSION', 'tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/MUST_VERSION') }}
+    - name: Cache uv packages
+      uses: actions/cache@v4
+      with:
+        path: ~/.cache/uv
+        key: uv-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}
+    - name: Cache npm packages
+      uses: actions/cache@v4
+      with:
+        path: node_modules
+        key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
+    - name: Set up environment and install dependencies
+      shell: bash
+      run: ./bin/setup

+
+# Build elfutils libelf (configure + make + install). When
+# UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1 the entire sequence runs inside a single container
+# invocation so that the hundreds of small autotools probe compilations don't
+# each spawn their own container (as the per-call pattern in bin/g++ would).
+#
+# Called by CMake's ExternalProject_Add — do not invoke directly.
+# Usage: .build-elfutils.sh <SOURCE_DIR> <BINARY_DIR> <INSTALL_DIR>
+
+set -e
+
+SOURCE_DIR=$1
+BINARY_DIR=$2
+INSTALL_DIR=$3
+
+ROOT=$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")
+[ -f "${ROOT}/../.toolchain-local" ] && source "${ROOT}/../.toolchain-local"
+
+if [ "${UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER:-0}" = "1" ]; then
+  # shellcheck source=../bin/.toolchain.sh
+  source "${ROOT}/../bin/.toolchain.sh"
+  cd "$BINARY_DIR"
+  _setup_toolchain_run
+  exec $TOOLCHAIN_RUN bash -c '
+    set -e
+    cd "$1"
+    "$2/configure" \
+      --prefix="$3" \
+      --disable-shared \
+      --enable-static \
+      --disable-nls \
+      --disable-debuginfod \
+      --disable-libdebuginfod \
+      --without-zstd \
+      --without-bzlib \
+      --without-lzma
+    make -s -C lib
+    make -s -C libelf
+    make -s -C libelf install
+  ' -- "$BINARY_DIR" "$SOURCE_DIR" "$INSTALL_DIR"
+else
+  cd "$BINARY_DIR"
+  "$SOURCE_DIR/configure" \
+    --prefix="$INSTALL_DIR" \
+    --disable-shared \
+    --enable-static \
+    --disable-nls \
+    --disable-debuginfod \
+    --disable-libdebuginfod \

+    --without-bzlib \

+#
+# Toolchain container for riscv-unified-db.
+# Based on AlmaLinux 8 + gcc-toolset-14 (same base as build_z3_with_docker.sh).
+# The RISC-V GNU toolchain is built from source to ensure compatibility with
+# AlmaLinux 8's glibc 2.28 (pre-built tarballs from riscv-collab require glibc >= 2.31).
+#
+# Build:
+#   docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t udb-toolchain .
+#   docker build --platform linux/arm64 -t udb-toolchain .
+FROM almalinux:8
+LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/riscv/riscv-unified-db
+
+# Install host C/C++ toolchain (gcc-toolset-14), make, gdb, clang
+# (for clang-format/clang-tidy), and build dependencies.
+# Build deps for riscv-gnu-toolchain: autoconf automake python3 libmpc-devel
+# mpfr-devel gmp-devel gawk bison flex texinfo patchutils zlib-devel expat-devel
+RUN dnf install -y dnf-plugins-core \
+    && dnf config-manager --set-enabled powertools \
+    && dnf install -y \
+        gcc-toolset-14 \
+        gcc-toolset-14-gcc-c++ \
+        make \
+        gdb \
+        clang-tools-extra \
+        elfutils-libelf-devel \
+        gmp-devel \
+        curl \
+        git \
+        autoconf \
+        automake \
+        python3 \
+        libmpc-devel \
+        mpfr-devel \
+        gawk \
+        bison \
+        flex \
+        texinfo \
+        patchutils \
+        zlib-devel \
+        expat-devel \
+    && dnf clean all
+
+ENV PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/bin:$PATH
+ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
+
+# Build riscv-gnu-toolchain from source.
+# Produces both:
+#   riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc      (bare-metal ELF cross-compiler)
+#   riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-gcc (Linux glibc cross-compiler)
+#
+# Source: https://github.com/riscv-collab/riscv-gnu-toolchain
+ARG RISCV_TOOLCHAIN_VERSION=2026.04.05
+
+RUN set -e; \
+    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${RISCV_TOOLCHAIN_VERSION}" \
+        https://github.com/riscv-collab/riscv-gnu-toolchain \
+        /tmp/riscv-gnu-toolchain; \
+    cd /tmp/riscv-gnu-toolchain; \
+    git config submodule.dejagnu.update none; \
+    git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1; \
+    \
+    # Configure for rv64gc / lp64d (no multilib — keeps build fast) \
+    ./configure --prefix=/opt/riscv --with-arch=rv64gc --with-abi=lp64d; \

+    make -j"$(nproc)"; \
+    \
+    # Build Linux-GNU (glibc) toolchain (riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-*) \
+    make linux -j"$(nproc)"; \
+    \
+    # Clean up source tree to reduce image size \
+    cd /; \
+    rm -rf /tmp/riscv-gnu-toolchain

+ENV PATH=/opt/riscv/bin:$PATH

+#!/bin/bash
+# Shared helper for toolchain container wrappers.
+# Source this file; do not execute it directly.
+# Usage: source "$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")/.toolchain.sh"
+
+# Compute repo root from the location of this file (bin/.toolchain.sh → repo root)
+_TOOLCHAIN_SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")
+ROOT=$(dirname "${_TOOLCHAIN_SCRIPT_DIR}")
+
+# Detect container runtime: prefer docker, fall back to podman, respect DOCKER/PODMAN env vars.
+# Searches PATH and common absolute locations so this works even when PATH is restricted.
+_get_toolchain_runtime() {
+  local _docker _podman
+  _docker="${DOCKER:-$(PATH="$PATH:/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin" command -v docker 2>/dev/null)}"
+  _podman="${PODMAN:-$(PATH="$PATH:/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin" command -v podman 2>/dev/null)}"
+  if [ -n "$_docker" ] && [ -x "$_docker" ]; then
+    echo "$_docker"
+  elif [ -n "$_podman" ] && [ -x "$_podman" ]; then
+    echo "$_podman"
+  else
+    echo ""
+  fi
+}
+
+# Compute toolchain container image tag as first 16 chars of SHA256 of .toolchain/Dockerfile
+_TOOLCHAIN_HASH=$(sha256sum "${ROOT}/.toolchain/Dockerfile" | cut -c1-16)
+TOOLCHAIN_IMAGE="ghcr.io/riscv/udb-toolchain:${_TOOLCHAIN_HASH}"
+
+# Set up TOOLCHAIN_RUN for container invocations.
+# Only called when UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1.
+_setup_toolchain_run() {
+  local runtime
+  runtime=$(_get_toolchain_runtime)
+  if [ -z "$runtime" ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: Neither docker nor podman found. Install one to use UDB_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER=1." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+
+  # Check if image exists locally; if not, try to pull

+#!/bin/bash
+# bin/doctor — check that the development environment is correctly set up.
+
+ROOT=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")")
+
+# Load local toolchain preference (same as ./do)
+[ -f "${ROOT}/.toolchain-local" ] && source "${ROOT}/.toolchain-local"
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Color / formatting helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+if [[ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ]] && [[ -t 1 ]]; then
+  _C_BOLD=$'\033[1m'
+  _C_RESET=$'\033[0m'
+  _C_GREEN=$'\033[32m'
+  _C_RED=$'\033[31m'
+  _C_YELLOW=$'\033[33m'
+  _C_CYAN=$'\033[36m'
+  _C_DIM=$'\033[2m'
+else
+  _C_BOLD='' _C_RESET='' _C_GREEN='' _C_RED='' _C_YELLOW='' _C_CYAN='' _C_DIM=''
+fi
+
+_pass() { printf "  ${_C_BOLD}${_C_GREEN}✓${_C_RESET}  %s\n" "$1"; }
+_fail() { printf "  ${_C_BOLD}${_C_RED}✗${_C_RESET}  %s\n" "$1"; }
+_warn() { printf "  ${_C_BOLD}${_C_YELLOW}!${_C_RESET}  %s\n" "$1"; }
+_info() { printf "     ${_C_DIM}%s${_C_RESET}\n" "$1"; }
+
+_section() {
+  printf "\n${_C_BOLD}${_C_CYAN}[%s]${_C_RESET}" "$1"
+  if [[ -n "${2:-}" ]]; then
+    printf "  ${_C_DIM}%s${_C_RESET}" "$2"
+  fi
+  printf "\n"
+}
+
+_check_native_binary() {
+  local name="$1" bin_path="$2"
+  if [[ -f "$bin_path" ]]; then
+    _pass "$name binary available"
+    _record_pass
+  else
+    _fail "$name binary not downloaded"
+    _info "Expected: $bin_path"
+    _info "Fix: run \`bin/setup\` to download native dependencies"
+    _record_fail
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Counters
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_PASS_COUNT=0
+_FAIL_COUNT=0
+_WARN_COUNT=0
+
+_record_pass() { ((_PASS_COUNT++)) || true; }
+_record_fail() { ((_FAIL_COUNT++)) || true; }
+_record_warn() { ((_WARN_COUNT++)) || true; }
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Section 1: Core Prerequisites
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_check_core_prerequisites() {
+  _section "Core Prerequisites"
+
+  # git
+  if command -v git > /dev/null 2>&1; then
+    local git_ver
+    git_ver=$(git --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?' | head -1)
+    _pass "git  ${_C_DIM}${git_ver}${_C_RESET}"
+    _record_pass
+  else
+    _fail "git not found"
+    _info "Fix: install git via your OS package manager (e.g. apt install git)"
+    _record_fail
+  fi
+
+  # mise
+  if command -v mise > /dev/null 2>&1; then
+    local mise_ver
+    mise_ver=$(mise --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?' | head -1)
+    _pass "mise  ${_C_DIM}${mise_ver}${_C_RESET}"
+    _record_pass
+  else
+    _fail "mise not found"
+    _info "Fix: curl https://mise.run | sh"
+    _info "     or see https://mise.jdx.dev for other install methods"
+    _record_fail
+    # mise is required for everything else — bail early on the mise-tool checks
+    _MISE_MISSING=1
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Section 2: Mise Tools
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# Map of mise tool name -> binary name (only entries that differ)
+declare -A _MISE_BINARY_OVERRIDE=(
+  ["github-cli"]="gh"
+)
+
+_check_mise_tool() {
+  local tool="$1"
+  local binary="${_MISE_BINARY_OVERRIDE[$tool]:-$tool}"
+
+  local bin_path
+  bin_path=$(mise which "$binary" 2>/dev/null)
+  if [[ -z "$bin_path" ]]; then
+    _fail "$tool not installed"
+    _info "Fix: run \`mise install\` in the repo root"
+    _record_fail
+    return
+  fi
+
+  # Extract a clean version number from --version output.
+  # Some tools (shellcheck) put the version on a "version: X.Y.Z" line.
+  # Others put it inline on the first line.
+  local version_output version
+  version_output=$("$bin_path" --version 2>/dev/null)
+  # Try "version: X.Y.Z" pattern first (shellcheck style)
+  version=$(printf '%s' "$version_output" | grep -m1 -oE '^version: [0-9]+\.[0-9]+[.0-9]*' | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+[.0-9]*')
+  if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
+    # Grab the first X.Y[.Z] token from the first line
+    version=$(printf '%s' "$version_output" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?' | head -1)
+  fi
+  if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
+    version=$(printf '%s' "$version_output" | head -1)
+  fi
+  _pass "$tool  ${_C_DIM}$version${_C_RESET}"
+  _record_pass
+}

+_check_mise_tools() {

+

+    _record_warn
+    return
+  fi

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+_check_ruby_ecosystem() {

+    _record_warn
+    return
+  fi
+
+  local bundle_bin
+  bundle_bin=$(mise which bundle 2>/dev/null)
+  if [[ -z "$bundle_bin" ]]; then
+    _fail "bundle not found (is ruby installed via mise?)"
+    _info "Fix: run \`mise install\`"
+    _record_fail
+    _GEMS_FAILED=1
+    return
+  fi
+
+  if BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$ROOT/Gemfile" "$bundle_bin" check > /dev/null 2>&1; then
+    _pass "Gemfile gems installed"
+    _record_pass
+  else
+    _fail "Gemfile gems not installed"
+    _info "Fix: run \`bundle install\` in the repo root"
+    _record_fail
+    _GEMS_FAILED=1
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Section 4: Node.js Ecosystem
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_check_node_ecosystem() {
+  _section "Node.js Ecosystem"
+
+  if [[ -d "$ROOT/node_modules" ]]; then
+    _pass "node_modules present"
+    _record_pass
+  else
+    _fail "node_modules not found"
+    _info "Fix: run \`npm ci\` in the repo root"
+    _record_fail
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Section 5: Developer Setup
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_check_developer_setup() {
+  _section "Developer Setup"
+
+  # Pre-commit hook (skip in CI)
+  if [[ -v GITHUB_ACTIONS ]]; then
+    _info "Pre-commit hook check skipped (CI environment)"

+    local git_hooks_dir

+    if [[ -f "${git_hooks_dir}/hooks/pre-commit" ]]; then
+      _pass "Pre-commit hook installed"
+      _record_pass
+    else
+      _warn "Pre-commit hook not installed"
+      _info "Fix: run \`bin/install_hooks\` in the repo root"
+      _record_warn
+    fi
+
+    if [[ -f "${git_hooks_dir}/hooks/post-merge" ]]; then
+      _pass "Post-merge hook installed"
+      _record_pass
+    else
+      _warn "Post-merge hook not installed"
+      _info "Fix: run \`bin/install_hooks\` in the repo root"
+      _record_warn
+    fi
+
+    if [[ -f "${git_hooks_dir}/hooks/post-checkout" ]]; then
+      _pass "Post-checkout hook installed"
+      _record_pass
+    else
+      _warn "Post-checkout hook not installed"
+      _info "Fix: run \`bin/install_hooks\` in the repo root"
+      _record_warn
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  # Native dependencies (z3, espresso, eqntott, must) — downloaded by bin/setup via extconf.rb
+  if [[ -n "${_GEMS_FAILED:-}" ]]; then
+    _warn "Native deps check skipped (Ruby gems not installed)"

+    return
+  fi

+  if [[ -n "${_MISE_MISSING:-}" ]]; then

+    return
+  fi

+  local ruby_bin
+  ruby_bin=$(mise which ruby 2>/dev/null)
+  if [[ -z "$ruby_bin" ]]; then

+  local cpu

+    arm64|aarch64) cpu="arm64" ;;

+  local espresso_version

+
+  local eqntott_version
+  eqntott_version=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$ROOT/tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/EQNTOTT_VERSION")

+  local must_version

+  _check_native_binary "must" "$xdg_cache/udb/must/$must_version/$cpu/must"
+
+  local z3_version
+  z3_version=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$ROOT/tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/Z3_VERSION")

+
+  local z3_lib

+  if [[ ! -f "$z3_lib" ]]; then

+      _record_warn
+    fi
+  fi
